1.w: A psalm of praise; by David. I will extol you, my God, O King. I will praise your name continually.

2.w: Every day I will praise you. I will praise your name continually.

3.w: The Lord is great and certainly worthy of praise. No one can fathom his greatness.

4.w: One generation will praise your deeds to another and tell about your mighty acts.

5.w: I will focus on your honor and majestic splendor and your amazing deeds.

6.w: They will proclaim the power of your awesome acts. I will declare your great deeds.

7.w: They will talk about the fame of your great kindness and sing about your justice.

8.w: The Lord is merciful and compassionate; he is patient and demonstrates great loyal love.

9.w: The Lord is good to all and has compassion on all he has made.

10.w: All your works will give thanks to you, Lord. Your loyal followers will praise you.

11.w: They will proclaim the splendor of your kingdom; they will tell about your power,

12.w: so that mankind might acknowledge your mighty acts and the majestic splendor of your kingdom.

13.w: Your kingdom is an eternal kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations.

14.w: The Lord supports all who fall and lifts up all who are bent over.

15.w: Everything looks to you in anticipation, and you provide them with food on a regular basis.

16.w: You open your hand and fill every living thing with the food it desires.

17.w: The Lord is just in all his actions and exhibits love in all he does.

18.w: The Lord is near all who cry out to him, all who cry out to him sincerely.

19.w: He satisfies the desire of his loyal followers; he hears their cry for help and delivers them.

20.w: The Lord protects all those who love him, but he destroys all the wicked.

21.w: My mouth will praise the Lord. Let all who live praise his holy name forever.
